Preserve the detached beta caveat. No extra text.

Render one finished static factual editorial illustration for a premium advanced textbook. Use a 1200 by 630 wide native composition; white ground, crisp dark ink, restrained indigo, teal, and terracotta highlights, clean modern large sans-serif, high-contrast flat editorial linework with subtle cutaway shading. Fill the broad white canvas with the mechanism without adding bars or shrinking a different aspect ratio. At least 12 individually useful objects and at least two visually differentiated substages. No human figures, avatars, shields, gears, logos, brands, realism, pseudo-text, microstrokes, invented gauges, controls or success marks.

Left file-location stack, central matching policy plate over an in-place file cutaway, right audit and outage fixtures, bottom left caveat.

Differentiate ordinary file and encrypted outer layers with diagonal broad bands and a sectioned protective envelope, not a shield. Keep fixed registration visible through both states. At right draw separate audit receipt tile and external key-service line with an obvious gap marking an outage, no arrow between the independent fixtures.

Unmatched file has no encryption path; audit is observational and key-service alerts describe service trouble, not automatic recovery or guaranteed access.

Visible text allowlist, exactly once per label and no other text: "Drive files", "Rule match", "Encrypt in place", "Same file URL", "Audit and key alerts", "Eligible beta only".
